<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wave Speaker](/Feats.aspx?ID=5348) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Merfolk" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=761" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 37

</column>

---

Being part fish yourself, you can speak the language of the sea. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) skill with [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531) that have the [amphibious](/Traits.aspx?ID=529) trait, [aquatic](/Traits.aspx?ID=533) trait, or a swim Speed, such as fish, crabs, and some seabirds (like penguins). The GM determines which animals count for this ability.
